themes.consensus_view: Banks agree the Fed has turned hawkish under new Chair Warsh, with the dot plot now signaling possible rate hikes, but they split on whether those hikes actually happen this year or the Fed stays on hold.

facts_agreed.claim: The Fed has shifted to a hawkish stance, with the dot plot now signaling possible rate hikes rather than cuts.
evidence_quotes: 9 of the 18 officials in the dot plot signalled there should be a rate hike

facts_agreed.claim: Sticky inflation is the force behind the Fed's harder line, requiring the central bank to back its tough language with action.
evidence_quotes: We believe the Fed will need to back its strong language with action
We now expect the Fed to hike 75bp this year in Sep, Oct, and Dec

facts_contested.claim: Whether the Fed actually delivers rate hikes this year
facts_contested.for_evidence: We now expect the Fed to hike 75bp this year in Sep, Oct, and Dec
facts_contested.against_evidence: we continue to see a 2026 rate hike as unlikely

facts_contested.claim: Whether the hawkish stance will persist
facts_contested.against_evidence: we have our doubts how long this hawkish fervor can last

themes.consensus_view: Banks broadly expect Gulf oil exports to recover as the Strait of Hormuz reopens and US-Iran talks progress, with Goldman already cutting its oil price forecast, though some supply may be permanently lost.

facts_agreed.claim: Banks treat the Strait of Hormuz reopening and US-Iran negotiations as the key driver pointing Gulf oil supply back toward normal.
evidence_quotes: the market is increasingly pricing in a return toward pre-war export levels
Strait of Hormuz energy flow restoration
US-Iran agreement impact on oil prices
Strait of Hormuz supply flow recovery

themes.consensus_view: Banks across seven desks reference US-Iran high-level talks in Switzerland as a live oil and geopolitical catalyst, but none has staked a clear directional view on whether a deal holds.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks are tracking the US-Iran high-level talks in Switzerland as an active de-escalation and oil-supply catalyst this window.

themes.consensus_view: Banks across several desks flag semiconductors as a crowded, heavily-bought sector seeing record money inflows, but only The Market Ear stakes a clear bullish view while the rest just note the trend without taking a side.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple desks reference semiconductors as a sector drawing record inflows and heavy positioning this window.
evidence_quotes: net allocations now at record highs

themes.consensus_view: Banks broadly agree the AI buildout keeps drawing huge committed spending from the big cloud companies, with the open question being whether firms keep spending freely or start treating that spend as a cost line to watch.

facts_agreed.claim: The big cloud companies (hyperscalers) remain committed to heavy AI capital spending that shows little sign of slowing.
evidence_quotes: AI capex investments (i.e. capacity/infrastructure to facilitate the training & inferencing of AI workloads) remain elevated
First-quarter results confirmed that hyperscalers remain committed to their heavy capital expenditure plans.
Our house view remains constructive on the AI capex outlook

facts_agreed.claim: The driver of AI spending has shifted toward scarcity of computing power, keeping the incentive to spend more rather than less.
evidence_quotes: The monetization narrative has flipped from 'can they generate enough revenue' to 'there isn't enough compute'
For now, however, the incentive remains to spend more, not less.

facts_contested.claim: whether AI spending stays cost-blind or starts being treated as a watched cost line
facts_contested.for_evidence: For now, however, the incentive remains to spend more, not less.
facts_contested.against_evidence: Perhaps we are moving towards a recognition of the spend and cost as a line item

themes.consensus_view: Four research desks reference new Fed Chair Warsh's task forces on the central bank's operating framework, AI, and productivity as a developing story, but none has staked out a directional market view on what the reviews will conclude.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks flag Chair Warsh's Fed task forces — covering the operating framework, AI, and productivity — as a topic on their radar this window.
evidence_quotes: Fed task forces on AI and productivity

themes.theme: leveraged etf and hedge fund activity
themes.consensus_view: Several trading desks flag a sharp jump in leveraged ETF assets and hedge fund borrowing as a live market force, but none has staked a clear up-or-down call on what it means for prices.

facts_agreed.claim: Banks point to fast-growing leveraged ETFs and rising hedge fund leverage as a notable feature of current positioning.
evidence_quotes: Retail participation in leveraged single-stock ETFs
